## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

### Calcs

The isotope ratio of VSMOW is `0.0020052` or 2005.20 ppm.

```{r}
R18O_VSMOW = 0.0020052

df <- tibble(
  F18O = seq(0.00001, 0.1, by = 0.0001),
  R18O = F18O / (1 - F18O),
  d18O = (R18O / R18O_VSMOW) - 1,
  d18O_permil = d18O * 1000
)

df |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = F18O,
      y = d18O_permil
    )
  ) +
  geom_line()
```
